name: Seq2act code (google-research)
notes: Scoped to the seq2act directory of the google-research monorepo. The README says AndroidHowTo and PixelHelp were re-created from public sources and give slightly different results than the paper; the data are generated or downloaded separately, and a pre-trained end-to-end grounding checkpoint is linked from Cloud Storage. The monorepo's Apache-2.0 LICENSE covers code. github.com/deepneuralmachine/seq2act-tensorflow is an unofficial 2020 copy of this directory.
summary: TensorFlow code for mapping natural-language instructions to Android UI action sequences, with phrase-tuple extraction and grounding models and pipelines for AndroidHowTo, RicoSCA and PixelHelp.
